primary_ablation: LIS/256, candidate_shared; full_b96 minus each drop-one_b96; three paired source seeds
primary_supervision_control: full_b96 minus each single_b96; secondary full_b32 minus single_b32; same total labels and optimizer updates
secondary_removal_control: full_b128 minus drop-one_b96 retains per-task exposure but changes total labels
primary_novel_prediction: LIS/256 shared; four frozen variants from native_confirmation weights; all four previously untrained task sets retained
qualitative_novel_hypothesis: mean paired-random gain of novel_records and novel_minima_pair exceeds novel_peak_mixed and novel_valley_mixed; exploratory, fixed before new training
sampling: every step advances the previous 32-index sampler; smaller batches use its prefix; larger batches append draws from a separate RNG; same length sequence and core indices across all conditions
limitations: Three paired seeds conditional on the same source-data world; exploratory follow-up selected using earlier outcomes.
Total labels and optimizer updates are matched, but tasks allocate these labels across different numbers of permutation inputs per update.
The source pool is reused for causal-comparison control; the common support and target-test pools are globally new.
Four novel task sets do not establish cross-domain or broad task-set generalization; unknown audited actions are not proof of absent relations.
